title: Those Kinds of Crushes
style: Pop, low, dark lower-register male vocals, warm and rounded, rising to a gang chorus; layered distorted guitars build into the final refrain while the melody ends on an unresolved note; punchy drum kit, electric bass, keyboard chords; fast-paced d-minor drive.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Those kinds of crushes last
Through decades, come what may
I liked them in the past
I like them still today

[Pre-Chorus]
A line I won’t cross
A door I won’t try
There’s no gain, no loss
So I let it lie

[Chorus]
Longing keeps me safe
No try, no fail
Crushes keep me safe
Nothing to derail

[Verse 2]
Age shows in the face
But the core holds its place
Every old crush
Still gives me a rush

[Pre-Chorus]

There’s no gain, no loss
So I let it lie

[Chorus]
Longing keeps me safe
No try, no fail
Crushes keep me safe
Nothing to derail

[Bridge]
They won’t know
That they ever were
They won’t know
That they still stir
